mapper.select:
select bq.sys_id, bq.qna_title, su.user_nm as write_user_name, bq.qna_description, bq.insert_datetime as write_datetime, bq.file_ulid, bq.answer_yn, su2.user_nm as answer_user_name, bq.answer_datetime, bq.answer_description from brd_qna bq left join sys_user su on su.user_id = bq.insert_user_id left join sys_user su2 on su2.user_id = bq.answer_user_id where 1=1
and (bq.qna_title like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') or bq.qna_description like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
and bq.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and bq.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into brd_qna ( sys_id , qna_title , qna_description , delete_yn , file_ulid , answer_yn , answer_user_id , answer_datetime , answer_description , insert_user_id , insert_datetime , sys_plant_cd ) values ( #{qnaRequest.sysId}, #{qnaRequest.qnaTitle}, #{qnaRequest.qnaDescription}, 'N', #{qnaRequest.fileUlid}, 'N', null, null, null, #{userId}, now(), #{sysPlantCd} )
mapper.update: update brd_qna set qna_title = #{qnaRequest.qnaTitle}, qna_description = #{qnaRequest.qnaDescription}, modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() where 1=1 and sys_id = #{qnaRequest.sysId}
mapper.delete: update brd_qna set delete_yn = 'Y', modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() where 1=1 and sys_id = #{qnaRequest.sysId}
